conversion.original_title: 重载返回失败时Alertmanager应怎样验收现状？

body:
## 操作任务
实现apply_config(base,path,candidate,request)。base/path仅指题定自有临时Alertmanager进程及配置文件，candidate为已审查的JSON格式YAML配置文本，request(method,url,payload=None)返回HTTP状态码与JSON或文本。读取/api/v2/status的config.original为重载前证据，将candidate以UTF8写到指定文件并POST /-/reload，再核对运行配置和/metrics的alertmanager_config_last_reload_successful。拒绝时必须证明指标为0且实际配置与此前语义一致，返回applied=False/effective=实际旧配置字典/reload_success=False；文件保留失败候选以便诊断，不把写文件当应用成功，不偷偷重启、自动放宽路由或回退文件。成功时必须证明指标为1且可见运行route包含候选route各项、receiver名称及顺序与候选一致，返回applied=True/effective=实际配置字典/reload_success=True；证据矛盾抛RuntimeError。真实进程测试先发送到old，缺失receiver的配置重载被拒后仍到old，修正后同一PID和uptime的新告警到new。配置解析采用yaml.safe_load；服务端返回的默认字段需以运行语义为准，验收候选不要求省略默认项与展开默认项的字典完全相等。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1 Windows原生进程；私有回环HTTP webhook、独立临时数据目录，真实配置解析和热重载。没有生产路由、外部聊天/邮件通道、多节点HA、秘密轮换或宿主服务变更。主配置使用YAML兼容JSON，不需要系统服务安装。原题无独立故障编号，本实操不增加故障完成数。
状态接口中的webhook URL会脱敏为<secret>，不能从此接口证明敏感URL相等。只核对候选声明的route字段及receiver名称/顺序（服务端可展开默认字段）；接收目的地必须由题中真实本地通知验证，不把脱敏占位符当实际URL。候选duration采用该版本规范写法。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import datetime,json,pathlib,shutil,socket,subprocess,tempfile,threading,time,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
import yaml,task
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
seen=[]
class Receiver(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_POST(self):
  seen.append((self.path,json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))))
  self.send_response(200);self.send_header("Content-Length","0");self.end_headers()
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
hook=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Receiver);thread=threading.Thread(target=hook.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
def request(method,url,payload=None):
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b"" if method=="POST" else None),method=method,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=3) as r:status,raw=r.status,r.read().decode()
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status,raw=e.code,e.read().decode()
 try:return status,json.loads(raw)
 except ValueError:return status,raw
def config(receiver):
 return {"route":{"receiver":receiver,"group_by":["alertname"],"group_wait":"0s","group_interval":"1s","repeat_interval":"1h"},"receivers":[{"name":name,"webhook_configs":[{"url":"http://127.0.0.1:"+str(hook.server_port)+"/"+name}]} for name in ["old","new"]]}
def delivered(base,name,path):
 now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
 alert={"labels":{"alertname":name,"scope":"private-reload-acceptance"},"annotations":{"summary":"local synthetic validation"},"startsAt":now.isoformat(),"endsAt":(now+datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()}
 assert request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",[alert])[0]==200
 limit=time.monotonic()+7
 while time.monotonic()<limit:
  found=[p for p,payload in seen if any(a["labels"]["alertname"]==name for a in payload["alerts"])]
  if found:assert set(found)=={path};return
  time.sleep(.05)
 raise AssertionError("native webhook not delivered to expected effective receiver")
proc=None
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-am-reload-") as temp:
  root=pathlib.Path(temp);path=root/"config.json";old=config("old");new=config("new");path.write_text(json.dumps(old),encoding="utf8")
  with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));port=s.getsockname()[1]
  base="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(port)
  with (root/"server.log").open("wb") as log:
   proc=subprocess.Popen([binary,"--config.file="+str(path),"--storage.path="+str(root/"data"),"--web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:"+str(port),"--cluster.listen-address=","--log.level=error"],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   try:
    limit=time.monotonic()+12
    while True:
     try:
      if request("GET",base+"/-/ready")[0]==200:break
     except OSError:pass
     if proc.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>limit:raise RuntimeError("NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: private Alertmanager startup failed")
     time.sleep(.05)
    pid=proc.pid;before=request("GET",base+"/api/v2/status")[1]
    delivered(base,"InitialOld","/old")
    broken=config("missing");candidate=json.dumps(broken)
    print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: real rejected reload and runtime configuration witness",flush=True)
    result=task.apply_config(base,path,candidate,request)
    assert result=={"applied":False,"effective":yaml.safe_load(before["config"]["original"]),"reload_success":False},result
    assert json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf8"))==broken,"must not silently rewrite failed on-disk candidate"
    assert proc.poll() is None and proc.pid==pid
    delivered(base,"AfterRejectedReload","/old")
    print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_REJECTED_RELOAD_METRIC_ZERO_STATUS_OLD_DISK_NEW_WEBHOOK_OLD",flush=True)
    result=task.apply_config(base,path,json.dumps(new),request)
    assert result["applied"] is True and result["reload_success"] is True and result["effective"]["route"]["receiver"]=="new"
    assert proc.poll() is None and proc.pid==pid
    delivered(base,"AfterAcceptedReload","/new")
    assert request("GET",base+"/api/v2/status")[1]["uptime"]==before["uptime"]
    print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_REPAIRED_RELOAD_SAME_PID_UPTIME_METRIC_ONE_STATUS_NEW_WEBHOOK_NEW",flush=True)
   finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:proc.terminate()
    try:proc.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait(timeout=5)
finally:
 hook.shutdown();hook.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
